keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Romain Faivre (Auxerre).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Monaco 0, Auxerre 1. Romain Faivre (Auxerre) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Marvin Senaya.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Monaco. Folarin Balogun replaces Takumi Minamino.
Substitution, Monaco. Mathys Detourbet replaces Flávio Nazinho.
Substitution, Monaco. Edan Diop replaces Denis Zakaria.
Substitution, Auxerre. Kévin Danois replaces Rémy Labeau Lascary.
Substitution, Auxerre. Christ Makosso replaces Telli Siwe because of an injury.
Substitution, Auxerre. Lamine Sy replaces Marvin Senaya.
Substitution, Monaco. Ilies Belmokhtar replaces Matthis Abline.
Substitution, Auxerre. Arthur Piedfort replaces Pierre Ekwah.
Goal! Monaco 1, Auxerre 1. Edan Diop (Monaco) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Vanderson.
Paul Nardi (Auxerre) is shown the yellow card.
